scope: All 1,979 supplied already-positive English predicates individually read with their supplied context and subject profile. English aspect review only; no new Spanish/English lexical equivalence approvals.
reviewLimits: Modes are positive selected background-state or ordinary ongoing-event readings, not universal translations or exhaustive English aspect possibilities. No habitual used-to template is approved. State-past does not approve completed-event simple past. Progressive approval does not change the predicate, complements, lexical sense, subject profile or source morphology guards. Input context must remain visible; AGID and BE forms still require generation checks and the other independent review intersection. Independent model judgment, not native-human certification.

approved.frame: pour from one container to another
commit a violent or criminal attack

rejected.reason: Active haloing is not a confidently ordinary ongoing reading in the supplied unqualified frame; a static-light result should not be mistaken for an event.
Sight has an achievement/spotting reading here; an ordinary ongoing frame is uncertain without shifting to a gun-aiming or repeated-sightings sense.

LAST expresses duration; simple-past lasted normally bounds the episode rather than supplying a background state. Progressive was lasting is chiefly natural with an added comparative/duration qualification, absent here. Withheld conservatively rather than inventing that context.
Active enamoring/enamouring is not a confidently ordinary ongoing reading; the common passive enamored state would change the frame.

BE WIDOWED denotes the change/event here. Was widowed would normally present the completed bereavement, while was being widowed is not an ordinary ongoing English frame. A separately reviewed became/was becoming a widow frame would be needed.

FIND SOMETHING is an achievement/discovery frame. Was finding something lacks a confidently ordinary ongoing reading without replacing discovery with searching or imposing repeated discoveries; found something is not a background-state reading.

INTUIT, explicitly defined as know intuitively, lacks a confidently ordinary ongoing English reading; simple-past intuited commonly reports an intuitive realization rather than an established background state. Withheld conservatively.
